entries.text: The Databricks adapter now requests the bundled SQLGlot runtime's opt-in `safe_division` rewrite through `apply_rewrite` after alias deduplication. Every division, including nested ones, still becomes `TRY_DIVIDE`, so a zero divisor still returns NULL. Queries without a division are now re-rendered by the runtime (for example comma joins become `CROSS JOIN`) instead of being passed through verbatim; the result sets are unchanged.
